source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Heater and Air Conditioning, p.1A-45

procedures.title: Vacuum supply for A/C
notes: The Corvette has no separate A/C vacuum tank; the A/C draws vacuum from the production tank in the left fender area.

procedures.title: Kick pad valve and plenum valve: description
notes: A vacuum tank and check valve keep the air door from moving with engine vacuum changes (see figures 54-57 in the manual for kick pad valves).
The Corvette uses plenum valves to let outside air into the system.
